The Router's severity of 2.5 for the spoon is justified despite the Perceptual Auditor's miss, as AI often struggles with metallic reflections. The boundary bleeding is a classic generative artifact where distinct materials merge. The overall image quality is good, but these subtle physical inconsistencies prevent a perfect artifact score. It is significantly better than Reference 2 (altar) but lacks the crisp physical realism of Reference 3 (rifle).
